observations.observed_fact: Report describes4277 playerprofiles and2686 groups. D&D share wording explicitly refers to all group posts ever. PF2 is104 groups/663 profiles; PF1 is48 groups. Campaign and frequency labels and a909-response closure survey are also reported.
observations.interpretation: Platform recruitment corpus with mixed/insufficiently specified time bases, not a census of played campaigns or uniqueGMs. PF editions separated here; Remaster distinction unavailable.
observations.period: Report2026-10-06,updated10-25; exact extraction cutoff not stated
observations.geography_language: English public pages; platform users self-select. Report says halfUS,56countries among locatedusers; not population weighting.
limitations: No row-level export or uniqueGM denominator in report.
909 called GMs by author, but per-post closure collection and repeat-response dedup not specified; do not relabel as909verifieduniqueGMs.
Closure filled status is not a dated session attendance record.
No own regionalmap/hexcrawl/newmap field or cross-tab; p_create unknown.

source.locator: Description; Game info; Organizer; Game Master

observations.observed_fact: Resolved post uses D&D2024 tag, weekly schedule, organizer user10579,GM1/1, and says session0 waits for enough players. Organizer page shows two different advertised games.
observations.interpretation: One organizer can produce several posts. Schedule/level text alone does not verify played date; one may contain ongoing-play self-report while another awaits start. DND2024 not evidence for DND5-2014 ruleprofile.
observations.geography_language: English public pages; platform users self-select. Report says halfUS,56countries among locatedusers; not population weighting.
limitations: No session log or attendance proof read.
Account is observable organizer key, not verified person; do not equate organizer and GM in every post.
Paid professionalGM example is purposeful counterexample, not a representative sample.
Two resolved sources refer to the same post/account; not independent campaigns/people samples.

findings.finding: At least two separate obstacles to activeGM census: posts can lackGM and one organizer has severalgames. Active/cumulative counters also differ. No multiplication or global extrapolation justified.
Played-session dates, verifiedhuman dedup, GMrole perpost and own regionalmap/newhexcreation need remain unknown.

ranking_consequence: No new M/p/T/R/C numbers or rank changes proposed.104PF2 posts are a bounded recruitment signal, not104RemasterGMs and not a replacement for Foundryproxy. No OSRfamily sum becomes a singlegame score.
development_consequence: PendingPF2-FILL1/EXPORT1 not reprioritized by this dataset. Campaign/homebrew tags do not prove unmet mapgeneration/export need; no new backlogtasks.
selection_scope: No comprehensive scrape or campaigncensus; two reportdefinitions and purposeful unitcounterexamples only.
source_access_errors: One dynamiclist click resolved a differenttitle as indices shifted; recorded actualresolved URL and itscontent. Second staleclick failed; no data inferred from it.
